source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: How should you save a skill instruction file after editing it?

options.text: As rich text with visible Markdown headings
options.feedback: Markdown-looking headings do not determine the saved format. Rich-text formatting can prevent the file from functioning as intended.

options.text: As an image with the instruction text visible
options.feedback: Visible instructions are useful to a reader, but the demonstrated workflow saves the editable instruction file as plain-text Markdown.

options.text: As plain-text Markdown with the right name
options.feedback: Check both the actual text format and the filename. An added .txt extension or rich-text format can interfere with the intended skill file.

options.text: As a formatted document with a .md label
options.feedback: Renaming a formatted document does not establish that its contents are plain text. The saved format and the filename both matter.
